newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka stocks in impressive second qrtr growth.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka stocks in impressive second qrtr growth.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks continued to perform well in the second quarter to June on the back of improved interim profits posted by most local companies, the Colombo Stock Exchange said in its quarterly report on Tuesday.
"The all share index crossed the 800 point mark for the first time since April 1995 during the quarter," the report said.
The index, which gained 154.4 points in the quarter to June, closed 10.1 points lower at 855.7 on Monday.
Turnover in the second quarter rose sharply to 6.4 billion rupees, up from 2.2 billion in the pevious quarter, the exchange said.
It said foreign participation in the market rose slightly to 40 percent during the quarter to June from 38 percent in the previous three months.
Foreign net inflow in the market was 1.5 billion rupees.
Sectoral performance was in line with rising indices with only two sectoral stocks recording declines.
"Land and property sector companies did not do well in the first half of 1997," the report said.
There was only one intial public offering, by Lighthouse Hotel Ltd, that opened on the market in the second quarter.
The stock exchange said it introduced its on-screen trading system in early June, which was expected to improve market liquidity.
The new system is scheduled to be officially launched on August 11.
